summary: Master the real estate development process with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to excel in the industry today.
lede: Real estate development training helps property professionals assess and manage projects from site selection through construction and asset management. It covers feasibility analysis, financial modeling, land due diligence, zoning and permitting, stakeholder engagement, construction planning, and asset optimization, supporting structured decisions about project risks, costs, and progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must navigate, evaluate, and manage the full real estate development lifecycle with discipline and accountability. It is designed for: Real Estate Developer:
audience: Lead full-cycle development projects from concept
Project Manager: Oversee construction timelines, budgets
Investment Analyst: Evaluate feasibility, financial models
Land Acquisition Specialist: Conduct due diligence
Development Consultant: Provide feasibility analysis, capital
Construction Manager: Manage contractor selection, schedules
Property Manager: Optimize asset performance through tenant
Risk Manager: Identify, assess, and mitigate development
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites required. Working knowledge of basic real estate terms (e.g., NOI, cap rate, zoning) is helpful. No coding or advanced finance software needed—all modeling uses Excel templates provided. Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises (software pre-installed not required).
